name: Time zones
description: A day of hours across several places: what time it is in each, whether it is a reasonable hour to call, and when the clocks change.
author: intrf4ce (from Kompas)

prompts.name: time
prompts.description: The time across places, on the stage
prompts.text: Put a timezones element on a slide showing {args}, and tell me briefly what time it is in each place and when it would be sensible to call.
prompts.default: the places in my settings, or here and wherever we last talked about
